result.summary: The complete approved contract is satisfied by the supplied source and evidence. The required npm run check passed all 42 tests, and the previous duplicate-order and focus-management findings are resolved.

priorDispositions.reason: parseDocument now tracks item order values in a Set and rejects duplicates; the committed storage-recovery test covers duplicate sort orders as a load failure.
The current delete flow no longer programmatically focuses the undo control; undo remains exposed through a polite live region without focus transfer.
